risks.risk: Console model/storage not confirmed (Xbox One vs One S vs One X affects price). Photos don’t show a readable model label.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the console label/sticker showing the exact model (e.g., One / One S / One X) and storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value Xbox One variant among the closest matches (worst case for model uncertainty).

risks.risk: Not confirmed working (disc drive/RROD/overheating/controller drift). Photos can’t verify gameplay.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip of the console powering on to the dashboard and launching a game (or running a built-in test) with both controllers connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst case).

risks.risk: Package contents not confirmed (what exactly is included beyond the 2 pads).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of everything in the box/bag laid out (console, both controllers, cables, headset, games/discs, and any FC26 items).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + 2 controllers only (worst case: no extra games/accessories).

risks.risk: Controller condition not confirmed (stick drift, button issues, battery/charging).
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing both controllers in use (moving sticks, pressing all buttons) and battery/charging status if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers may need service (worst case).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console’s model/storage label (sticker) so we can confirm Xbox One / One S / One X.
Short power-on + dashboard video, then launching a game (or running a test) to confirm it works.
Photo/video of the full FC26 package contents laid out (all accessories and any games/discs).
Video showing both controllers working (all buttons + stick movement) and charging/battery status.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox console with 2 controllers, but the exact Xbox One model and working status/package contents are not verifiable remotely, so a safe price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
